definitions.explanation: The technology or process by which a computer identifies and processes objects, faces, text, or patterns within digital images.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧ (image; picture) and ⟦{認識|にんしき}→認識：05090_ninshiki⟧ (recognition; perception). A key term in modern technology, especially in AI and machine learning. Image recognition is used in everything from smartphone cameras to medical diagnostics and self-driving cars.
